title: The Gourmet King and the bitter man

cues.text: Paulownia Mall, Fountain Square. A chubby student in your school's uniform sits on a bench, looking up at you as you stand before him.
The student is on his feet, waving his arms at you in annoyance. A bitter-looking man in glasses walks up to the two of you, and the student scurries around behind you.
The man turns and walks off into the crowd. You turn to watch him go.
Wincing in pain, Nozomi runs off.
